content: EMSY is a protein encoded by the EMSY gene in humans. EMSY has been implicated in clinical conditions, specifically demonstrating an association with atopy, a predisposition to develop allergic hypersensitivity, and an increased susceptibility to poly-sensitization, which refers to sensitivity to multiple allergens. EMSY has been shown to interact with several other proteins, including ZMYND11, a protein involved in chromatin regulation; BRCA2, a tumor suppressor protein critical for DNA repair; and CBX1, a component of the heterochromatin protein complex involved in gene silencing and chromatin structure maintenance.
